messages.content: A chargeback is when a customer disputes a payment through their bank instead of asking the seller directly, and the bank pulls the money back.
Thik ache: chargeback mane customer bank-er kache complain kore j eta tar transaction na, ar bank taka ferot niye nei - seller-er double loss hoy, taka o jai content o jai.
